name: Kemet: Blood and Sand

categories.label: Battle FP (permanent)
categories.hint: 1 per won attack where the attacker keeps a Troop in the zone.

categories.label: Divine FP (permanent)
categories.hint: Night phase: controlling 2+ Temples or the Sanctuary of All Gods, plus Divine FP from tiles and DI effects.

categories.label: Power tile FP (permanent)
categories.hint: Permanent FP gained by buying specific Power tiles.

categories.label: Temple FP (temporary)
categories.hint: 1 per Temple you currently control; lost when you leave it empty.

categories.label: Pyramid FP (temporary)
categories.hint: 1 per level 4 Pyramid you control in an opponent's District; lost if you leave.

endCondition.description: At the start of your turn (before playing an Action token), if you have 9+ FP total and no other player has more, you win immediately.

notes: family: area-control-fame-race. No end-of-game scoring: the game is won by reaching 9 FP (temporary + permanent) on your own turn with nobody ahead, so opponents get a chance to respond. Rulebook states no explicit tiebreak beyond 'no other player has more FP'; if several players sit at 9+ tied, play continues. Temporary FP count toward the 9. Expansions (Book of the Dead, Rise of the Gods) not modelled.
